fare_type: Adult one-way standard ticket, as published in ERL's fare tables. ERL states online purchases get 10% off; that discount is not applied here.

erl-klia-ekspres.note: ERL publishes KLIA Ekspres fares for KL Sentral - KLIA (T1 & T2) only; there is no Ekspres fare for KLIA T1 - KLIA T2.

notes.text: KLIA Transit concessions (Malaysian senior citizens 60+, registered disabled persons, students 16+ and in higher learning): one-way fare less 30%, all sectors. Airline crew, airport staff and licensed tourist guides: RM35 one-way KL Sentral - KLIA (T1 & T2), RM30 one-way Bandar Tasik Selatan - KLIA (T1 & T2). Registration required.
KLIA Ekspres: children 6-15 RM25 single; children under 6 free (max 3 per adult). No published concession fare; ERL asks disabled/senior passengers to write in.
KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit tickets are not interchangeable (different ticketing systems).
